name: Thirty-One (Scat)
description: Thirty-One, also known as Scat or Blitz, is a classic accumulation game for two or more players. The goal is to obtain a hand with a point total as close to 31 as possible in a single suit. It is widely played in Northwest Europe and North America and is a staple of pub culture.

content.text: Thirty-One, also known as Scat or Blitz, is a classic accumulation game for two or more players. The goal is to obtain a hand with a point total as close to 31 as possible in a single suit. It is widely played in Northwest Europe and North America and is a staple of pub culture.
The game's roots go back to the 15th century, with variants like 'Vingt-et-un' and 'Bone-Ace'. The modern form solidified in the 19th century.
From 2 to 9 or more people can play. The game is often best with 3 players but works well with a larger group.
Standard deck, three coins or tokens per player (for lives), score sheet.
Dealer deals 3 cards to each player, one at a time, and 3 cards face-up to the table (the 'widow'). Remaining cards form the stock.

items.text: Blitz: Standard North American name where 31 is called a Blitz.
